title: Custom Race Suit
description: Fully bespoke leather race suit built from your own measurements. Your panel layout, colors, and leather grade. Add-ons available: airbag, CE armor, liner.

title: Replica Suit
description: Recreates a specific rider or team livery to your spec. Note your rider/details at checkout. Add-ons available: airbag, CE armor, liner.

title: Speed Suit
description: Pre-designed leather race suit, upgraded leather grade and protection, faster turnaround than full custom. CE-rated armor pockets included.

title: The Visionary
description: Pre-designed cowhide leather race suit, ready to order without a full custom design process. CE-rated inner protection included.

title: SWR Blade V1 Race Glove
description: Single cuff race glove (Blade V1), leather with TPU knuckle/finger protection and palm padding. Quick-secure closure.

title: SWR Blade V2 Race Glove
description: Blade V2 race glove, leather with TPU knuckle/finger protection and palm padding. Quick-secure closure.

title: SWR Race Glove
description: Double cuff race glove, leather with TPU knuckle/finger protection and palm padding. Built for track use.

title: SWR Street Glove
description: Leather street glove with TPU knuckle/finger protection and palm padding. Quick, easy securing mechanism.

title: Supersonic Boots
description: Breathable race boot with perforated upper/side panels and a snug ankle fit for added crash protection.

title: Warp Speed Boots
description: CE certified race boot with Axial Distortion Control ankle system, nylon heel inserts, and perforated upper.

title: Custom Leather Jacket
description: Standalone custom leather jacket, made to measure. Pairs with matching Custom Leather Pants for a full combo look.

title: Custom Leather Pants
description: Standalone custom leather pants, made to measure. Pairs with matching Custom Leather Jacket for a full combo look.
